title: ARSIA DPoP Proof JWT Payload
description: Schema for the decoded payload of a DPoP proof JWT per ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3 (verification) and RFC 9449 §4. The header schema is in $defs/dpop-header.

allOf.description: Unique identifier for this DPoP proof (UUID v4). Accepted only once per target URI within the acceptance window — an ARSIA requirement (ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3 check 13).

htm.description: HTTP method of the request. ARSIA requires POST for all inbox deliveries. ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3 check 8, ARSIA-Core.md §8.1.

htu.description: HTTP URI of the target inbox endpoint. MUST match the request URI, ignoring query and fragment. ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3 check 9.

iat.description: Issued-at time as NumericDate. MUST be within the clock skew tolerance of the receiver's clock — ±300 seconds by default, or the applicable compliance profile's clock_skew_seconds (ARSIA-Core.md §8.3). ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3 check 11.

ath.description: Base64url-encoded SHA-256 hash of the access token. Binds the DPoP proof to a specific access token. ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3 check 12, RFC 9449 §4.2.

nonce.description: Server-provided nonce. MUST be present when the receiving agent requires one; it carries the value the receiving agent supplied via the DPoP-Nonce HTTP header (RFC 9449 §4.2, §8, §9; ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3). Syntax: nonce = 1*NQCHAR (RFC 9449 §8.1; NQCHAR per RFC 6749 Appendix A).

dpop-header.title: ARSIA DPoP Proof JWT Header
dpop-header.description: JOSE header for ARSIA DPoP proof JWTs. ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3 checks 4-7.

typ.description: Token type. MUST be 'dpop+jwt' per RFC 9449 §4.2.

alg.description: Signing algorithm. ARSIA requires EdDSA (Ed25519). ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3 check 5, ARSIA-Core.md §5.1.

jwk.description: The public key (JWK) corresponding to the signing key — public key only: no private key member such as d (RFC 9449 §4.3, ARSIA-Identity.md §3.3 check 7). Its JWK SHA-256 Thumbprint (RFC 7638) MUST equal the cnf.jkt of the access token (check 12).
